DESCRIPTION.general: Required. General configuration for the File Integrity utility.
DESCRIPTION.general.algorithm: Required string naming a hashlib-supported algorithm with a fixed-length hexdigest, such as sha256, sha512 or md5. Unsupported algorithms fail hashing operations; variable-length SHAKE algorithms are not supported by this utility.
DESCRIPTION.general.target_dir: Required. Base directory inspected by File Integrity. Directory operations use this path automatically and file selections are resolved relative to this directory.
DESCRIPTION.general.manifest_dir: Required. Directory where checksum manifests are stored. Relative paths are resolved from the program working directory.
